csv_project_name: CA for Obsolete Federal Pacific Electric Main Distribution
csv_scope_of_work: The Lawrence Housing Authority through the U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development(HUD) is seeking the services of a qualified "Designer" within the meaning of M.G.L. Chapter 7, Section 38A , to provide a feasibility study, cost estimating, professional design, bidding and construction administration services for the complete replacement of the obsolete Federal Pacific Electric (FPE) main distribution switch gear,building transformer, individual apartment panels, and any ancillary equipment related to the electrical distribution,within our occupied five story, 76 unit 10-6 elderly housing development located at 65 Union Street,Lawrence, MA 01840.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Civil Engineering, Construction/Project Management, Cost Estimating, Feasibility Studies, Environmental Engineering/Planning/Design, Electrical Engineering
